title: Staff smp modpack
description: The smp modpack for the staff smp
body:
# Staff SMP Modpack

Welcome to **Staff SMP**, a lightweight but feature-packed Minecraft experience designed for smoother gameplay, better visuals, improved multiplayer interaction, and useful quality-of-life upgrades while keeping the vanilla Minecraft feel intact.

## 🚀 Performance & Optimization

This modpack includes a collection of performance-focused mods that dramatically improve FPS, reduce memory usage, and provide a smoother multiplayer experience.

### Included Performance Mods
- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- EntityCulling
- VMP (Very Many Players)
- Clumps
- Fast IP Ping
- Spark

These mods work together to optimize rendering, game logic, networking, and memory management for both singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay.

---

## 🎨 Visual Enhancements

Staff SMP improves Minecraft's visuals without changing its core gameplay.

### Visual Mods
- Iris Shaders
- Continuity
- Zoomify
- Status Effect Bars
- Armor HUD
- Durability Tooltip
- Boat View

### Included Shader Packs
- Complementary Reimagined
- Bliss Shaders
- Solas Shader

Choose between realistic lighting, vibrant colors, or performance-friendly enhancements to customize your experience.

---

## 🗺️ Exploration & Navigation

### Xaero's Minimap
Navigate the world more efficiently with:
- Real-time minimap
- Waypoints
- Death markers
- Coordinate tracking

Perfect for exploring, building projects, and locating friends on the server.

---

## 🏗️ Building & Technical Tools

Builders and technical players have access to several powerful tools.

### Included Building Utilities
- Litematica
- MaLiLib
- Mouse Tweaks
- Controlling
- Searchables

Create schematics, manage inventories faster, and organize keybinds with ease.

---

## 🎙️ Multiplayer Features

### Simple Voice Chat
Talk to nearby players using proximity voice chat for a more immersive multiplayer experience.

### Additional Multiplayer Support
- Placeholder API
- Enhanced server compatibility tools

---

## 🍎 Quality of Life Improvements

Small improvements that make everyday gameplay better.

### Included QoL Mods
- AppleSkin
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- Mod Menu
- Resourcify
- No Resource Pack Warnings

Features include:
- Hunger and saturation previews
- Shulker box inventory previews
- Easy mod configuration
- In-game resource pack browsing
- Cleaner pack loading

---

## 🎨 Included Resource Packs

Customize the look of Minecraft with optional resource packs included in the modpack.

### Resource Packs
- Staff SMP Pack
- Bare Bones
- Enchant Icons
- Fast Better Grass
- New Glowing Ores
- No Pumpkin Blur
- PVP Optimizer
- Redstone Tweaks
- Visual Armor Trims
- Sodium Translations

These packs provide cleaner textures, better visibility, enhanced PvP readability, and improved overall aesthetics.

---

## 🔧 Core Libraries & Dependencies

The modpack includes several libraries required for compatibility and configuration.

### Core Dependencies
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Cloth Config
- Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)
- SuperMartijn642 Config Library
- UkuLib
- CWB Framework

---

## ⭐ What Staff SMP Offers

✔ Better FPS and performance

✔ Optional shaders and enhanced graphics

✔ Proximity voice chat

✔ Powerful building tools

✔ Improved user interface

✔ Better multiplayer experience

✔ Vanilla-friendly gameplay

✔ Custom resource packs and visual upgrades

Staff SMP is designed to deliver the best possible multiplayer Minecraft experience while staying true to vanilla gameplay. Whether you're building massive projects, exploring with friends, or simply enjoying a smoother game, this modpack provides the tools and enhancements needed to make every session better.
